title: Gemini CLI discontinued, replaced by Antigravity CLI on June 18, 2026
description: Google announced that Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions stopped serving requests for Google AI Pro and Ultra users on June 18, 2026. Users were required to migrate to Antigravity CLI, with model endpoints to be updated before June 30, 2026 to avoid service disruption.

community_feedback.quote: Gemini CLI was great, despite some of its shortfalls. It's a shame that it's effectively being discontinued
Antigravity is basically useless right now. The Gemini CLI is...

title: Continue.dev acquired by Cursor, repository read-only from June 18, 2026
description: Continue.dev has been acquired by Cursor. The official website now redirects to announce the acquisition, and the continuedev/continue GitHub repository is no longer actively maintained and is read-only for all users. The last extension update was on June 18, 2026 (version 2.1.0).

community_feedback.quote: Continue has been acquired by Cursor. Our mission has always been to ensure developers are amplified, not automated

title: Windsurf rebranded to Devin Desktop on June 2, 2026
description: On June 2, 2026, Cognition AI rebranded Windsurf to 'Devin Desktop'. The change reflects the product's evolution into a command center for managing local and cloud agents. Windsurf had been integrating Devin cloud agents since May 2026, leading to the full rebrand delivered as an over-the-air update.

community_feedback.quote: Windsurf Becomes Devin Desktop in 2026: What Changed
Saying goodbye to Windsurf and transforming it to Devin Desktop

title: Codex CLI revamp with new features and DigitalOcean plugin (June 2026)
description: OpenAI introduced upgrades to Codex in June 2026, featuring a revamped Codex CLI, a new Codex IDE extension, and enhanced features. A new DigitalOcean plugin was added to Codex provisioning capabilities. CLI v0.89.0+ introduced a 'What's New' notification system for model usage guidance.

community_feedback.quote: Updated Codex limit system guidance
Reports of model capacity issues and CLI failures when using GPT-5.5 with xhigh reasoning effort
Users reporting Codex ignoring instructions and making unsafe patches

title: GitHub Copilot moves to usage-based billing on June 1, 2026
description: GitHub Copilot transitioned from request-based billing to usage-based billing on June 1, 2026. All Copilot plans now bill based on GitHub AI Credits consumed, replacing Premium Request Units (PRUs). Users on monthly Pro or Pro+ plans were automatically migrated to the new system.

community_feedback.quote: End of an Era [June 1, 2026] - GitHub Copilot models and prices

title: Week 24: /cd command and nested sub-agents (June 8-12, 2026)
description: Claude Code v2.1.166–v2.1.176 released June 8–12, 2026. Key features include /cd to move sessions to new working directories without rebuilding prompt cache, sub-agents can now spawn their own sub-agents (capped at five levels deep), --safe-mode for troubleshooting, and fallbackModel configuration.

community_feedback.quote: Starting June 15, 2026, Agent SDK and claude -p usage on subscription plans will draw from a new monthly Agent SDK credit
The post-June 15 pricing would significantly affect heavy users of non-interactive Claude features
Users discussing potentially 10x price increases under the new plan for certain usage patterns

title: June 2026: /automate skill, enhanced cloud agents, and improved Bugbot
description: Cursor's June 2026 update introduces the /automate skill for creating automations directly in agent sessions, new GitHub and Slack triggers, cloud environment setup in under 10 minutes, cloud subagents with /in-cloud, and Bugbot performance improvements (3x faster, 22% cheaper, finds 10% more bugs).

community_feedback.quote: damn, even automation can now be automated

title: Copilot CLI GA, Agent Finder, Auto Mode, and Claude Fable 5
description: June 2026 updates include Copilot CLI new terminal interface generally available (June 23), Agent Finder for GitHub Copilot (June 17), Auto Mode available for all users (June 17), Copilot app support for BYOK (June 23), Claude Fable 5 generally available (June 9), and numerous enhancements to Copilot code review, chat context, and enterprise features.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot now includes agent finder to discover and rank AI tools for tasks automatically
The new home for Copilot where you can 'direct agents in parallel' and 'land your PRs, all in one place'
GitHub Copilot Agent Mode automatically fixes code generation errors if it finds them

title: June 2026: Session folders, automations, and Devin Review enhancements
description: Devin's June 2026 updates include session folders for organization, !ultra and !fast mid-session toggles, smarter emoji reactions, custom OAuth for marketplace MCP servers, Devin Review improvements with pending PR cancellations on new commits, large paste auto-attach, personal automations, and numerous enterprise features including default member roles and V3 API enhancements.

community_feedback.quote: Devin didn't fail because the ambition was wrong. It failed because it aimed at a version of autonomy current models can't yet support
